The '''Penegelen Shards''' were a spherical cloud of tumbling fragments which orbited the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Penegelen]]in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]],<ref name="EGtW:AC" /> within the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] [[Penegelen system/Legends|of the same name]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> They consisted of substances such as scorched alloys or flash-frozen hunks of dirt and [[Stone/Legends|rock]]. [[Scientist/Legends|Scientists]] believed that the shards were the remnants of a shell that once encapsulated Penegelen. The shell was thought to have potentially been a creation of an ancient [[Species/Legends|species]] known as the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]].<ref name="EGtW:AC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Penegelen Shards were originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] source book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]], however the sidebar that would have mentioned the shards was cut before the book's release. The information regarding the shards was then released in [[2013]] as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut]]'', a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Jason Fry and [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from the ''Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="EGtW:AC" /> An update to the StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and Fry, placed the Penegelen system, and therefore the Penegelen Shards, in grid square L-14.<ref name="EAOC" />
